notes: Camif (camif.fr, France) - direct HTTP fetch, no WAF/block. Found the clearance family via sitemap.categories.xml: /c/destockage, /c/fin-de-serie, /c/seconde-chance. 'Destockage' (French for stock clearance/liquidation) is a genuine site-defined taxonomy concept, not a temporary promo: og:title 'Destockage : meubles, literie, deco, zero dechet', h1 'Destockage*', meta description 'produits de qualite en destockage a prix reduits' - a permanent discounted/outlet-style merchandising concept, clearly passing the Sale-vs-Clearance test. Breadcrumb on /c/fin-de-serie reads Accueil > Destockage > (current), and /c/destockage links to both /c/fin-de-serie and /c/seconde-chance once each (both children link back to /c/destockage) confirming genuine site-defined sub-structure: Destockage (general/own listing) > Fin de serie (end-of-line) and > Seconde chance (second-chance/returned-refurbished stock, og:title 'Destockage seconde chance'). All three are independently real PLPs (each has its own distinct product count, not merely a nav index), so kept as three sibling rows rather than collapsing. Qty verified via the site's rendered French 'N article(s)' header, cross-checked against data-product-id tile counts: destockage 36 articles = 36 tiles, no next-page link (exhausted, exact match); seconde-chance 1 article = 1 tile, no next-page (exact match); fin-de-serie 68 articles header, page 1 shows 46 tiles with a rel=next to page=2 present (header trusted per this site's proven reliable count-header pattern from the prior Home-Decor pass, consistent with un-paginated matches above; not re-crawled page-by-page as this is PLP-level not PDP-level extraction). SALE VS CLEARANCE: also found /c/toutes-nos-promotions (367 articles, h1 'Toutes nos promotions', meta 'Promos et bons plans Camif ... petits prix ... Paiement en 3x ou 4x sans frais') - this is a generic, temporary promotional/discount aggregator page with no permanence/outlet signal, so per brief it is explicitly EXCLUDED as Clearance (classic Sale/Promotions page, not Clearance). Checked main nav, footer, and both sitemap.categories.xml and sitemap.cms.xml for any other clearance/outlet term (destockage, fin-de-serie, outlet, derniere-chance, deuxieme-choix) - none found beyond the three rows below.
